hooks.command: cs="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR HEAD -- '*.cs' 2>/dev/null; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard -- '*.cs' 2>/dev/null)"; [ -z "$cs" ] && exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$cs" | sort -u | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -r dotnet format BinaryVibrance.Kaldra.slnx --include >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
